- sign_in: 84.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 86.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 83.1%, median 395s / mean 5815s

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 6 tests (up to +15.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 6 showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and 10 showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) and redesigns (redesign) were helpful, winning 2 tests each (up to +8.7% and +9.0%), though several hurt performance and most showed no clear effect.
Copy updates (copy) were helpful in 1 test (+5.7%), but showed no clear effect in 7 tests.
Step reordering (reorder), hints, notifications, and new flows produced no winning tests; step reordering hurt performance in 1 test (-3.8%) and no clear effect was seen in the rest.
Predictions underestimated several large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, -1.5% vs +9.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Companion Behavior Mode Selection Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen 'new_companion_behavior' after story screen where users choose their companion's primary activity style (Desk Companion, Active Playmate, Focus Partner).
candidates.why: Choose path has an 80.9% conversion rate and support emails indicate post-adoption confusion regarding companion behavior. New screens have a strong historical win rate (up to +15.4%).

new_companion_behavior.headline: Select Your Pet's Preferred Activity Style
new_companion_behavior.body: Choose how active or quiet you would like your companion to be on your desktop.

candidates.title: Compact Layout Account Preservation Sign-In Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign sign_in screen into a compact layout with an explicit pet account safety badge component.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in, and 2 noted sign-in screen stalls. Redesigns have proven +9.0% wins.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe

components.text: Your pet state is saved automatically to your profile

candidates.title: Pet Voice & Audio Accent Selection Screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen 'new_pet_voice_accent' before adoption certificate to let users pick their companion's sound reactions.
candidates.why: Adoption step takes a median of 89s (mean 1017s); adding emotional connection screens improves adoption completion and post-onboarding satisfaction.

new_pet_voice_accent.headline: Choose Companion Voice Accent
new_pet_voice_accent.body: Select how your pet sounds when greeting or seeking attention on your desktop.

candidates.title: Desktop Initialization Stage Progress Status
candidates.change: Add explicit desktop render stage progress text and engine status checklist to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a mean 2336s and 3 users reported pets failing to show on desktop. Waiting screen info updates won 3 past tests (up to +5.7%).

candidates.title: Stage Layout Desktop Control Action Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro into a stage layout featuring an interactive preview component demonstrating pet desktop commands.
candidates.why: Finish step dropoff is 83.1% and multiple support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet. Redesigns have won up to +9.0%.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop
home_intro.body: Right-click your companion anytime to access controls, switch modes, or hide them.

candidates.title: Full-Bleed Visual Layout for Choose Path
candidates.change: Update choose_path screen layout to full_bleed with large visual choice card components.
candidates.why: Choose path is the biggest funnel leak at 80.9% conversion. Layout updates have previously yielded wins up to +8.7%.

candidates.title: Pet Visual Preset Customization Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Add a new visual preset customization screen 'new_pet_style_preset' prior to photo upload in adoption.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets cited issues where making a custom pet failed or looked wrong. Adding a visual preset flow clarifies generation output expectations.

new_pet_style_preset.headline: Choose Visual Style Preset
new_pet_style_preset.body: Select the art style base for your companion before generating or custom painting.

candidates.title: Multi-Monitor Desktop Display Verification Screen
candidates.change: Insert 'new_display_verify' screen before waiting to help users set multi-monitor display options.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pet failing to show on desktop; multi-monitor setups frequently cause overlay placement issues.

new_display_verify.headline: Desktop Display & Overlay Setup
new_display_verify.body: Ensure your companion spawns on your primary screen or select multi-monitor mode.

candidates.title: Companion Quick Interaction Gesture Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated 'new_interaction_gestures' screen right after home intro showing quick mouse click gestures.
candidates.why: 3 support emails specifically asked how to interact with and talk to the pet post-onboarding. New screens show strong historical success (+15.4%).

new_interaction_gestures.headline: Quick Desktop Mouse Gestures
new_interaction_gestures.body: Single click to pet, double click to talk, and drag to place anywhere on screen.

candidates.title: Pet Account Protection Security Guarantee Hint
candidates.change: Add a security guarantee hint to the sign-in screen assuring users that sign-in preserves companion memory.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited fear or experience of pets missing/reset after sign-in. Clear hints reduce sign-in dropoff (84.3%).

sign_in.hint: Signing in backs up your pet's personality and unlocks cross-device sync securely.

components.text: Your pet progress is protected instantly upon sign-in.
